definitions.explanation: Pain in the lower back area, often caused by muscle strain, poor posture, or spinal problems.

examples.japanese: {長時間|ちょうじかん}のデスクワークで{腰痛|ようつう}になった。
examples.english: I developed lower back pain from long hours of desk work.

examples.japanese: {腰痛|ようつう}を{防|ふせ}ぐために{姿勢|しせい}に{気|き}をつけている。
examples.english: I'm careful about my posture to prevent back pain.

examples.japanese: {慢性|まんせい}の{腰痛|ようつう}に{悩|なや}まされている。
examples.english: I'm troubled by chronic lower back pain.

examples.japanese: {重|おも}い{荷物|にもつ}を{持|も}ち{上|あ}げたとき、{腰痛|ようつう}がひどくなった。
examples.english: My lower back pain got worse when I lifted a heavy load.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{腰痛|ようつう}{持|も}ちなので、{毎朝|まいあさ}ストレッチをして{体|からだ}をほぐしてから{仕事|しごと}に{行|い}く。
examples.english: My father has chronic back pain, so he stretches every morning to loosen up before going to work.

notes:
{腰痛|ようつう} refers to lower back pain. {腰|よう} means 'lower back/waist' and {痛|つう} means 'pain.'

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {腰痛|ようつう}になる: to get back pain
- {腰痛|ようつう}を{治|なお}す: to cure back pain
- {腰痛|ようつう}{持|も}ち: someone who has back pain issues
- {慢性|まんせい}{腰痛|ようつう}: chronic back pain
- {急性|きゅうせい}{腰痛|ようつう}: acute back pain
- ぎっくり{腰|ごし}: sudden back strain (slipped disc)

CAUSES:
- {姿勢|しせい}が{悪|わる}い: poor posture
- {運動|うんどう}{不足|ぶそく}: lack of exercise
- {重|おも}い{物|もの}を{持|も}つ: lifting heavy objects

TREATMENT:
- マッサージ: massage
- ストレッチ: stretching
- {整体|せいたい}: chiropractic care
